problem: The legend labels are swapped: the peaking series is labeled Adaptive and the flat series Vanilla, but the original has Vanilla as the peaking red curve and Adaptive as the flat blue curve.
suggested_fix: Bind legend labels to series by matching legend-marker color to the series color rather than by enumeration order.

problem: Only the two rising series are reconstructed while the two flat near-zero series (green and gold triangle markers) are dropped.
suggested_fix: Lower the per-series marker-cluster size threshold so flat low-amplitude series with distinct marker colors are still recovered.

problem: The five step-like series are reconstructed but several individual point colors are confused so the per-series value correspondence near the rises is noisy and the sharp blue step is split across colors.
suggested_fix: Improve per-marker color clustering so overlapping same-x markers of different series are assigned to the correct series.

problem: The stepping data series is labeled wRF and the rising data series is labeled EoS threshold, so the dotted EoS threshold reference line was promoted into a data series and labels are misassigned.
suggested_fix: Exclude dotted reference/threshold lines from series extraction and bind remaining labels by marker color.

problem: A spurious cluster of blue points around x=12 y=4-5 was reconstructed from the in-axes legend box markers and text.
suggested_fix: Suppress marker detections that fall inside the detected legend bounding box.

problem: A spurious cluster of blue points around x=7-13 y=-5 to -7.5 was reconstructed from the bottom in-axes legend box.
suggested_fix: Suppress marker detections that fall inside the detected legend bounding box.

problem: A spurious cluster of blue points around x=8-13 y=-5 to -7.5 was reconstructed from the in-axes legend box markers.
suggested_fix: Suppress marker detections that fall inside the detected legend bounding box.

problem: A spurious cluster of blue points around x=7-13 y=-5 to -7.5 was reconstructed from the in-axes legend box markers.
suggested_fix: Suppress marker detections that fall inside the detected legend bounding box.

problem: Data from the small inset zoom panel (y around -29 to -33) is merged into the main panel reconstruction as extra red and brown clusters near y=-40.
suggested_fix: Detect inset panel bounding boxes and exclude their marks from the main panel's extraction region.

problem: The original y-axis is logarithmic (10^0 to ~10^-6) but the reconstruction maps values to a linear scale from +50 to -40, so y calibration is wrong.
suggested_fix: Detect the log y-axis from tick labels and apply log-space calibration before inverting pixel-to-data mapping.

problem: The x-axis is reconstructed spanning 0 to 4e10 instead of the original 0 to ~450, a gross x calibration error of about eight orders of magnitude.
suggested_fix: Fix x-axis tick-label parsing so plain integer ticks are not misread with an erroneous exponent multiplier.

problem: The peaking series is labeled 's' (a stray fragment) instead of Linear Prop., so legend binding picked a wrong label token.
suggested_fix: Filter single-character or fragment tokens from legend-label candidates and bind labels by marker color.

problem: The reconstruction adds spurious flat horizontal series (e.g. a pink line near y=500) and stray dropping clusters that do not correspond to the original decaying curves.
suggested_fix: Suppress horizontal artifact series arising from gridlines/axis spans and discard isolated point clusters off the curve envelopes.

problem: A vertical pink point cluster on the left edge and scattered red EGM points at high y do not correspond to real marks on the smooth EGM curve.
suggested_fix: Drop edge/axis-region marker clusters and apply an outlier filter so scattered points far from a series trajectory are removed.
